name: claude-toolkit
description: Benjamin's Claude Code toolkit: mods, skills and an output style.

plugins.name: clear-caveman
plugins.description: Terse like Caveman, clear like Clear Answers: short plain replies, exact technical details, and one self-contained wrap-up after multi-step work.

plugins.name: codeburn
plugins.description: /codeburn runs CodeBurn (read-only) on your session logs and reports where tokens and money go, with fixes.

plugins.name: design-directions
plugins.description: When you ask for a design system from scratch, Claude proposes three distinct, visually rendered directions to pick from instead of asking open-ended questions.

plugins.name: model-router
plugins.description: Picks Haiku, Sonnet or Opus for each prompt and each subagent (swarm specialists included), with an Auto/Off dropdown above the prompt.

plugins.name: mods-skills-panel
plugins.description: A side panel listing your Claude Mods and Skills, how often each is used, which model each runs on, and what each does.

plugins.name: prompt-enhancer
plugins.description: Adds an Enhance button above the prompt box that rewrites your draft into a clearer prompt without sending it.

plugins.name: search-switch
plugins.description: A Search dropdown above the prompt: Native (WebSearch/WebFetch) or Exa / Firecrawl. Claude is told which to use, and the other side's tools are blocked.

plugins.name: swarm
plugins.description: An OpenSwarm-style team: /swarm hands one request to specialist agents (research, data analysis, slides, documents, images, video), shows their progress live in a panel, and collects the deliverables in one folder with a gallery page.

plugins.name: toolkit-setup
plugins.description: /toolkit-setup checks a machine and lists every install step, login and API key the toolkit needs, without ever asking for key values in chat.
